create.name: Meggan Watterson
create.bio:
Meggan Watterson is a feminist theologian and writer whose work centres on early Christian texts that were kept out of the New Testament, above all the Gospel of Mary, along with the Acts of Paul and Thecla. She studied at Harvard Divinity School, where she took a master's in theological studies, and at Union Theological Seminary in New York, where she earned a master of divinity. Her bestselling Mary Magdalene Revealed sits alongside The Girl Who Baptized Herself, Reveal and a book of advice on love and relationships, and she has created two oracle decks, one drawn from Mary Magdalene's story and one on the divine feminine.

At the heart of her teaching is the soul-voice meditation, a simple practice of resting attention in the heart and listening for the quiet voice of love beneath the ego. She reads the excluded gospels as living spiritual guidance, especially for women looking for their own authority. She leads the House of Mary Magdalene, an online community that meets on Zoom once a month to study these scriptures passage by passage, gives talks and retreats, including a weekend at Omega, and writes regularly on Substack.

books.title: Mary Magdalene Revealed: The First Apostle, Her Feminist Gospel & the Christianity We Haven't Tried Yet
books.author: Meggan Watterson
books.description: Her best-known book, which weaves a close reading of the Gospel of Mary with her own story. It presents Mary Magdalene as a spiritual teacher in her own right and draws out a practice of inner listening from the text.

books.title: The Girl Who Baptized Herself: How a Lost Scripture About a Saint Named Thecla Reveals the Power of Knowing Our Worth
books.author: Meggan Watterson
books.description: An exploration of the Acts of Paul and Thecla, a first-century text about a young woman who left an arranged life to follow her own calling. She uses the story to think about self-worth and spiritual independence today.

books.title: Reveal: A Sacred Manual for Getting Spiritually Naked
books.author: Meggan Watterson
books.description: Her first book, a memoir-led guide to seeking a direct, personal experience of the divine. It mixes her own search across traditions with practices for stripping away what stands between us and the sacred.

books.title: How to Love Yourself (and Sometimes Other People): Spiritual Advice for Modern Relationships
books.author: Lodro Rinzler, Meggan Watterson
books.description: A conversational book on dating, partnership and self-respect seen through a spiritual lens. Short chapters answer practical questions about love with an emphasis on first being kind to yourself.

books.title: The Mary Magdalene Oracle: A 44-Card Deck & Guidebook of Mary's Gospel & Legend
books.author: Meggan Watterson
books.description: A 44-card deck with a guidebook that turns themes from Mary's gospel and the legends around her into a daily reflective practice. Each card carries a short teaching and prompt.

books.title: The Divine Feminine Oracle: A 53-Card Deck & Guidebook for Embodying Love
books.author: Meggan Watterson
books.description: A 53-card deck featuring sacred women and goddesses from many traditions, with a guidebook for using them in reflection and prayer.

books.title: The Sutras Of Unspeakable Joy
books.author: Meggan Watterson
books.description: A small self-published collection of short contemplative sayings on joy, love and the inner life, meant to be read slowly.

courses.title: Mary Magdalene Revealed
courses.description: A weekend workshop at Omega's Rhinebeck campus on the Gospel of Mary and why it was excluded from the New Testament. Lectures and open discussion alternate with practice of the soul-voice meditation; no meditation experience is needed.

courses.title: The House of Mary Magdalene
courses.description: An online membership community that meets on Zoom on the first Sunday of each month from September to May to study the Gospel of Mary chapter by chapter. Members also get a library of past gatherings and can send in questions for her to answer.

free_resources.title: Soul-Voice Meditation
free_resources.description: A free audio download of her core practice: settling attention in the heart and listening inward.

free_resources.title: Prayer of The Heart - Meggan Watterson | Monday Meditation
free_resources.description: A seven-minute guided meditation for Hay House's Monday series, built around a short prayer repeated in the heart.

free_resources.title: The Soul Voice Meditation - Meggan Watterson
free_resources.description: A ten-minute filmed version of the soul-voice practice, recorded for Omega, in which she introduces the idea and then guides it.

flags: Tier borderline: ~92k followers, just under the 100k luminary line. She is a Hay House author with a Wall Street Journal bestseller (Mary Magdalene Revealed), so the owner may want to raise her to luminary for editorial stature; not raised here.
Email questions@megganwatterson.com is a team inbox ('email Meggan's team'), published on her Omega retreat page and the House of Mary Magdalene page.
All videos are on other channels (Hay House, TEDx, Ziva Meditation, Wanderlust, House of Mercy); she is the main speaker in each. The Ziva Meditation episode is a podcast interview.
How to Love Yourself (and Sometimes Other People) is co-written with Lodro Rinzler; check whether he is listed on Spiritpedia.
No physical base found, so availability is worldwide.

Podcast appearances where the host shares the floor heavily (We Can Do Hard Things, Dr. Mindy Pelz, Layla Martin and others) and the Kyle Gray unboxing video.
